messages:
sam: Hey team — running the sample-app quickstart on a new workspace and the very first request returns 402 Payment Required. Did I miss a billing step?

sam: ```bash
curl -i -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${REDWOOD_API_KEY}" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```

sam: ```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "billing_required",
    "message": "Workspace needs an active billing method or credits to use hosted inference",
    "code": 402
  }
}
```

liz: @sam are you using the org admin key or a workspace service key? billing is per-workspace for hosted infra.

sam: I used the key in the quickstart README (copied from Console > API keys). It says "Org API Key" on the page. Do we need to create a separate workspace service key?

ben: Org keys are read-only for some endpoints; hosted inference requires a workspace-level API key or a service account bound to that workspace. Try creating a "Workspace service key" in Console > Workspaces > <name> > API keys. Also check Console shows credits left.

carmen: Also check you didn't hit the free credits cap. New tenant credits are auto-applied but expire after usage. You can see billing status in Console -> Billing -> Usage.

sam: ok creating a workspace key now... (few secs)

infra-bot: Notice: policy enforces billing enabled for hosted_model.create on new tenants. See doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/self-serve/billing-guardrails

sam: switched to workspace service key — same curl but now returns 200 and a streaming chunk. Thanks! :tada:

ben: Awesome — leaving a note to add a quickstart callout about which key to use. @devex can we add a guardrail warning in the sample-app README?

carmen: Good idea. I'll open a small PR with a snippet and a line about "If you see 402, make sure workspace has active billing or workspace service key" :memo:

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/421 — verified, sample app now works for me. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
